blocks.html: Cross-Selling is a sales strategy where a company encourages an existing customer to purchase additional related or complementary products or services.

Cross-selling focuses on maximizing the value of existing customer relationships by առաջարկing solutions that enhance or complement the original purchase. It is widely used across industries to increase revenue without the higher costs associated with acquiring new customers.
Cross-selling involves identifying customer needs and recommending relevant add-ons or complementary offerings, such as:

items.html: Suggesting related products based on previous purchases
Offering bundled packages or service upgrades
Recommending tools or features that enhance usability
Using customer data and behavior to personalize recommendations

blocks.html: Effective cross-selling relies on timing, relevance, and a deep understanding of customer preferences.
Increases average order value and customer lifetime value (CLV)
Reduces reliance on new customer acquisition
A SaaS company selling a CRM platform recommends an email marketing integration or analytics add-on to existing users, helping them get more value from the core product.

Cross-selling is a powerful strategy for driving incremental revenue while delivering added value to customers. When done effectively, it creates a win-win by improving both business outcomes and customer experience.
